firstPlayerRule: Whoever painted most recently goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Play continues clockwise. On a turn, take an Art Card or complete a painting according to the normal rules.
In Painting with Vincent, the simulated player Vincent acts last. That variant is available for one or two human players.
The separate Solo Puzzle variant has only one player. This answer covers the ©2021 base-game manual, not the later second edition or expansion rules.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 3, 4, 7, 8. The original publisher hosts the complete eight-page Canvas_Rulebook_v09.pdf. Cover credits identify ©2021 R2i Games, Jeffrey Chin and Andrew Nerger. The first paragraph of On Your Turn on PDF page 4 chooses the latest painter and states clockwise play. Setup on page 3 gives each player four Inspiration Tokens. Page 7 keeps standard play except for its listed variants: Vincent is a simulated non-scoring participant who goes last; Solo Puzzle has one player. Page 8 changes scoring-card scenarios, not initial selection. These pages carry no printed page numbers. No second-edition rule is inferred from the current Tabletop Tycoon product listings.
